name: TrueLayer
description: Sync UK bank accounts and cards from TrueLayer into Securo: stable transaction IDs, pending transactions, balances and automatic token refresh.

network.purpose: Signs you in at your bank and exchanges the authorization code for API tokens.
Same sign-in for sandbox apps, whose client ID starts with sandbox-.
Reads accounts, cards, balances and transactions through the TrueLayer Data API.
Same data reads for sandbox apps.

integrations.name: TrueLayer
integrations.description: Sign in with your bank through TrueLayer. Accounts, cards and transactions sync as a connected bank in Securo.

fields.label: Days of history on first sync (optional, default 7)
Card account type: credit_card (default), checking or savings
